item.title: The 10 college majors with the highest unemployment
item.description: A new analysis from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York shows how recent graduates across 73 college majors fared in 2024.

item.title: Once-eradicated measles virus on the rise in Ohio
item.description: Once thought to have been effectively eradicated, measles are again on the rise, with Ohio being one of 20 states having reported cases in 2026.

item.title: What caused double-fatal semi-truck crash on US-30
item.description: U.S. Route 30 is closed in both directions near the state Route 511 intersection, due to a crash.

item.title: Some US schools cancel class pictures after online claims surrounding Epstein
item.description: Some school districts in the U.S. dropped plans for class pictures after widespread social media posts linked a billionaire with ties to Jeffrey Epstein to the photography giant Lifetouch, which on Friday called the claims “completely false.”

item.title: Watch: Body camera video shows sheriff K-9 'arrest' alleged robber

item.title: LeBron James becomes oldest player to have triple-double in NBA history
item.description: Deep in the 23rd season of the longest career in NBA history, LeBron James is still dropping triple-doubles — on the Dallas Mavericks and on Father Time.

item.description: Police detectives continue investigating after the owner of a Sandusky indoor playground was charged with sending sexually explicit messages to a minor.

item.title: Warming up! Several days could reach 50 -- here's when
item.description: Despite increasing clouds, this evening is quiet and dry. Temperatures are still in the lower to mid 30s. Winds will start to increase closer to midnight, making it feel a little chillier.
